en.headline: Woman dies after collapsing in Happy Valley flat, boyfriend reports
en.dek: Police said the 47-year-old was found unconscious by her boyfriend at a unit on Leighton Road late on Wednesday evening and later died in hospital.
body: Police said they received a report from a man on Wednesday evening that his 47-year-old girlfriend had collapsed inside a flat at 52 Leighton Road in Happy Valley.
Officers and ambulance crew attended the scene. The woman was unconscious and was taken to Ruttonjee Hospital, where she was later confirmed dead.
Police said the woman had a medical history. The cause of death is pending a post-mortem examination. The case is being handled as a death inquiry.

zh.headline: 跑馬地47歲女子單位暈倒送院不治
zh.dek: 警方表示，事主的男友周三晚上發現她在禮頓道單位內暈倒，送院後證實不治。
body: 警方表示，周三晚上接獲一名男子報案，指發現其47歲女友在跑馬地禮頓道52號一單位內暈倒。
人員到場，女子昏迷被送往律敦治醫院治理，其後被證實死亡。
警方了解女事主有身體病紀錄。死因有待驗屍後確定，案件列作屍體發現處理。
